inheritance_spec._note: Constance end_state is explicitly its OWN Maldives islands (addressable_market_count=1), so it must NOT inherit the full maldives-jih national pool. captive_pool_fraction required before cascade.

agg_rollup.phase_caps_LB89_doc: Per-market caps: Phase 1 ≤ 8 boats, Phase 2 ≤ 25 boats, Phase 3 = network-sum (unchanged). Prevents single-market dominance in near-term phase economics.

forward_sam._doc: Low-confidence / future-dated demand (e.g. Saudi-Red Sea 2030 destination caps). Computed at MID but held OUT of the near-term grounded floor and estimated_total; reported as forward-looking SAM only.

roadmap_quanta_lr_2026plus.note: Beyond Pioneer II 70nm range; need Quanta-LR (H2 2026+, capacity/capex not locked). Economics held out of near-term number per null-beats-guess.

end_state.headline: A branded foiling arrival layer across the Constance Hotels & Resorts luxury collection.
end_state.addressable_footprint: Every Constance Hotels & Resorts island in the Maldives, connected to Velana International and to each other by a fast, silent, zero-emission foiling fleet.
end_state.narrative: Steady state is a Constance Hotels & Resorts-branded foiling arrival network: jet-to-foil-to-villa on every island, the same calm quality end to end.

required_evidence: Exact Constance island set (own end_state islands only)
Numerator: Constance addressable transfer demand or room/night capacity with source
Denominator: maldives-jih national pool used by inheritance
Fraction = numerator/denominator with citations; never set to 1.0
